summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia filed a 6-K containing a notice regarding a scheduled cash dividend payment. The board authorized total dividends of ARS 39,999,772,000, payable in three installments, with the third installment of ARS 13,333,257,333.33 distributed to shareholders of record as of September 7, 2026. The dividend amounts to ARS 8.30 per share, subject to Argentine withholding taxes, and will be distributed through Caja de Valores, with ADR holders paid via BNY Mellon. This is routine dividend administration, not a special-situation event.
